what_it_does: This paper builds a frequency multiplier chain that converts lower frequencies into terahertz-range signals (0.27 THz) using a 65-nanometer CMOS process. It multiplies the input frequency by 18 by combining multiple multiplier stages that amplify specific harmonics (integer multiples of the input frequency). The design optimizes how each stage generates and amplifies these harmonics while rejecting unwanted frequency components.
